# watchpoint_monitor_dependency (Resource)

A directed dependency edge: the dependent monitor's alerts are dampened when its upstream is unhealthy. Exactly one of `depends_on_monitor_id` or `depends_on_group_id` must be set. This resource has no update endpoint; any change recreates the edge.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_monitor_dependency" "example" {
  dependent_monitor_id  = "mon_checkout"
  depends_on_monitor_id = "mon_db"
  description           = "Checkout depends on the primary database"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dependent_monitor_id` (String) The monitor whose alerts are dampened when the upstream is unhealthy.

### Optional

- `depends_on_group_id` (String) Upstream monitor group this edge depends on; expands to every member at walk time. Mutually exclusive with `depends_on_monitor_id`.
- `depends_on_monitor_id` (String) Upstream monitor this edge depends on. Mutually exclusive with `depends_on_group_id`.
- `description` (String) Free-form reason the edge exists.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `created_by_user_id` (String) User ID that created the edge.
- `id` (String) Dependency edge ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_monitor_dependency.example dep_001
```
